This gate uses the app-wide `installedApp.isUpdateAvailable` flag, which says nothing about *which* release the pending update refers to. So whenever the app has an update pending, selecting any timestamp-tracked release suppresses the "Open" state — including the release that is actually installed. Concretely, for a hash-tail app (e.g. installed `26.08.11f15e4`, update pending to `26.09.01abcdef`), opening the picker and selecting the installed release now yields "Install 26.08.11f15e4" instead of "Open", i.e. a button offering to (re)install the build already on the device.

Scope the suppression to the release the update targets (reuse `selectedIsLatestRelease`, which already handles a blank stored `latestVersion`), so the reused-tag fix still applies while an unrelated selection keeps the "Open" affordance. Note this requires declaring `selectedIsLatestRelease` above this block.
